filters.name: Ads & Trackers
filters.description: Comprehensive and curated to remove thousands of false positives that plague most community maintained lists.
filters.additional:
Relaxed Mode

Smallest block list, will only block very common ads and trackers. Least prone to false positives.

Balanced Mode

Medium sized block list, will block a lot more than the Relaxed mode, but still allow common affiliate and email tracking links.

Strict Mode

Will block the most ads and trackers, but also has the highest chance of false positives.

filters.name: Adult Content
filters.description: This filter blocks sexually explicit content. Handy on kid-friendly networks and those morally opposed to pornography.
filters.additional:
Relaxed Mode

Filter will block most popular adult themed websites and reduce chances of false positive blocks. This is the recommended setting.

Strict Mode

This Filter uses a much larger blocklist and will block more niche adult websites at the cost of more false positives.

filters.name: Artificial Intelligence
filters.description: This filter blocks domains that are used for generating and hosting AI generated content, reducing exposure to synthetic media sources.

filters.name: Clickbait
filters.description: Sites that intentionally, but not necessarily exclusively, publish hoaxes and disinformation for purposes other than satire.

filters.name: Crypto
filters.description: This filter blocks all cryptocurrency exchanges, crypto news sites and cryptomining services that mine cryptocurrency in your browser.

filters.name: Dating
filters.description: Not looking to meet local singles/bots in your area? This filter will help you achieve this goal.

filters.name: Drugs
filters.description: This filter contains sites that legally and illegally sell drugs, alcohol, tobacco and vape products.

filters.name: Dynamic DNS
filters.description: This filter contains dynamic DNS service hostnames which can sometimes be used to distribute malware and other malicious content.

filters.name: File Hosting
filters.description: This filter contains file hosting websites, cyberlockers and other file sharing websites that can be used to distribute malware and other malicious content.

filters.name: Gambling
filters.description: Blocks gambling sites. Prevent yourself, your employees or family members from gambling away their life savings.

filters.name: Games
filters.description: This filter blocks domains associated with video games, including gaming platforms, online game servers, update services, and related CDNs.

filters.name: Government Sites
filters.description: This filter contains all government TLDs and websites in most countries. Will not prevent you from paying taxes.

filters.name: IoT Telemetry
filters.description: This filter prevents smart devices from sending tracking and telemetry to manufacturers, which may break some poorly made devices.

filters.name: Malware
filters.description: Sites that are known to distribute malware or botnet command-and-control servers. There is almost no reason to disable this.
filters.additional:
Relaxed Mode

Will block only malicious domains.

Balanced Mode

Will block malicious domains and domains that resolve to malicious IP addresses.

Strict Mode

Just like Balanced, but will also block malicious domains using machine learning. There are 3 separate levels of strictness available.

filters.name: New Domains
filters.description: Blocks brand new domains commonly abused for malware distribution and control, with possible collateral blocking of legitimate new sites.
filters.additional:
Last Week

Blocks domains that were registered in the last week.

Last Month

Blocks domains that were registered in the last month.

filters.name: Phishing
filters.description: This list blocks phishing domains as well as domains that are similar to common websites you may be visiting.

filters.name: Social
filters.description: Social networks of the most pervasive privacy violators out there. This filter will block them and their associated trackers.

filters.name: Torrents & Piracy
filters.description: Blocks common torrent trackers, index sites, and piracy streaming services. It won’t stop torrents, only access to those sites and peer-discovery trackers.

filters.name: URL Shorteners
filters.description: Blocks common URL shorteners that hide link destinations. Often used to mask malicious links or track clicks and browsing behavior.

filters.name: VPN & DNS
filters.description: Blocks common VPN and DNS-over-HTTPS providers (except Control D). Useful for stopping DoH-based malware bypasses or restricting VPN use.
